style_context: House painting, surface preparation, primers and topcoats, color selection, and safe paint disposal

images.description: Clean educational sample board showing the same paint color applied in five side-by-side finish strips labeled flat, eggshell, satin, semi-gloss, and gloss, lit from one side so the reflected light clearly changes across the finishes, simple horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: Side-by-side sheen comparison under the same light shows how reflectivity changes surface appearance in a way text alone cannot make obvious

images.description: Four-panel realistic instructional sequence of a small damaged interior wall area being repaired, showing panel 1 cleaning loose debris, panel 2 applying patching compound with a putty knife, panel 3 sanding the dried patch smooth, and panel 4 rolling primer over the repaired spot, with a few clean callouts and arrows, minimal text, no branding
images.value: Step-by-step visual sequence shows the order and look of proper wall repair before painting, which is much clearer than text alone

images.description: Clean tabletop design board with a simple color wheel, two painted wood sample swatches in an analogous pairing and two in a complementary pairing, plus a small unfinished stool sketch beside the swatches to show how the colors could be applied to a real project, minimal horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: Connects color-wheel relationships to real painted sample swatches and a small project plan, helping the reader see harmony choices that are hard to picture from prose alone

images.description: Simple educational flow diagram showing leftover paint handled responsibly: a sealed labeled paint can, a crossed-out storm drain, a separate keep-for-reuse branch, and an approved recycling or drop-off destination, with arrows between steps and very short horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: Flow layout makes the safe disposal decision path visible at a glance, especially the contrast between approved handling and crossed-out unsafe dumping
